text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — prepping AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Need owners for billing SKU mapping, legal EULA variants, branding assets, and publisher portal smoke tests. Can we get owners and rough ETA? :wave:

Sam Ortiz: I can own billing SKU mapping. Will sync with finance and ops. ETA EOD Thu? :+1:

Liam Chen: I'll run publisher portal smoke tests and validate AMI/manifest upload flow. There's a flaky 500 on staging right now: https://staging-pub.redwood.internal/ops/123

Anita Rao (LegalOps): For contracts we need: 1) Master Publishing Agreement signed; 2) localized EULA per region (US/EU/APAC); 3) TAX/VAT attestation documents. Who is collecting the signed MPA?

Marketplace Bot: staging-slot reserved for listing 'redwood-inference' in AWS Marketplace on 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC. Invite: @Maya Patel, @Sam Ortiz, @Liam Chen

Maya Patel: Thanks — Sam taking billing is great. @Anita Rao can you confirm if the MPA template in /legal/pubs/mpa_v3.docx is final or needs sign-off? Also we need high-res logos (svg/png), short product blurb, and a 'getting started' quickstart URL.

Anita Rao (LegalOps): MPA v3 is the current template but marketing wants a line added about data processing. I'll post redline by tomorrow. Also need list of target markets to decide EU locale EULA text.

Sam Ortiz: I'll pull the SKU mapping spreadsheet tonight and post a link. Also, question — do we support metered usage or subscription bundle on launch? Need decision to map SKUs.

Maya Patel: Goal is to launch with subscription + trial. Metered can come later. For now map SKUs to 'subscription' tiers only.

Liam Chen: Smoke test plan (quick):
```
- create publisher account
- upload AMI/manifest
- run bootstrap install
- verify trial provisioning
- run sample inference request
```
I'll run this after Sam posts SKUs and after Anita posts MPA redline.

LegalOps: noted. @Maya Patel, please confirm final list of markets (US, CA, UK, DE, FR, AU, JP, SG)

Maya Patel: Confirmed that list. Also adding @SolutionsEng to review the quickstart content and @marketing for branding assets. Can solutions eng or marketing volunteer a contact?

Sam Ortiz: I'll loop in finance and add the SKU sheet to this thread: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/sku-mapping

Maya Patel: Great — let's aim to have MPA redline + SKU mapping + logos in this thread by EOD Thu so Liam can run portal smoke tests Fri morning. If blockers, callout here and we'll rebook staging slot. :calendar:

Liam Chen: Got it. I'll post smoke test results as screenshots and a short runbook note.

Marketplace Bot: Reminder: publishing slots are limited — if staging not used by 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC it will be released.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with calendar invites and a small checklist. /cc @Anita Rao @Sam Ortiz @Liam Chen
